integrity: Exact partition decomposition establishes the theorem; standard-library verifier gives finite independent cross-checks. No external or independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Formula applies to proper conflict-free open-neighborhood colorings of finite K_{m,n} minus a matching, with m,n at least two and all q nonnegative integers. It does not extend to arbitrary deleted-edge sets or list colors. The numerical crown chi specialization is already known. Literature checks cannot establish global publication priority.
title: The shared-palette polynomial of matching-deleted complete bipartite graphs
